proposals.before: Soon he was given the rank of vice president of the Censorate and appointed assistant commissioner at Yarkand.
proposals.after: Soon he was given the rank of vice banner commander and appointed assistant commissioner at Yarkand.
proposals.reason: 副都統 is a banner vice commander-in-chief rank, not a vice president of the Censorate.

proposals.before: He died soon after. The court granted him the posthumous rank of Grand Tutor, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and gave him the temple name Wenduan.
proposals.after: He died soon after. The court granted him the posthumous rank of Grand Tutor, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and gave him the posthumous name Wenduan.
proposals.reason: 諡 marks a posthumous name, not a temple name.

proposals.before: The court was stricken; Prince Zaiye was sent to offer libations, gold was granted for the funeral, and Tangjie was posthumously made grand guardian of the heir apparent with the temple name Wenqing.
proposals.after: The court was stricken; Prince Zaiye was sent to offer libations, gold was granted for the funeral, and Tangjie was posthumously made grand guardian of the heir apparent with the posthumous name Wenqing.
proposals.reason: 諡 marks a posthumous name, not a temple name.

proposals.before: Grand Secretary Sengbao arrived in command and demanded lavish supplies; Magistrate Wang Hong, crushed by the demand, tried to kill himself and barely survived.
proposals.after: Grand Secretariat Academician Sengbao arrived in command and demanded lavish supplies; Magistrate Wang Hong, crushed by the demand, tried to kill himself and barely survived.
proposals.reason: 內閣學士 is Grand Secretariat Academician, not Grand Secretary (大學士).

proposals.before: Grand Secretary Sengbao arrived at Hejian commanding troops and demanded supplies with great urgency; Magistrate Wang Hong, pressed to meet them, attempted suicide and nearly died.
proposals.after: Grand Secretariat Academician Sengbao arrived at Hejian commanding troops and demanded supplies with great urgency; Magistrate Wang Hong, pressed to meet them, attempted suicide and nearly died.
proposals.reason: 內閣學士 is Grand Secretariat Academician, not Grand Secretary (大學士).

decisions.reason: s0028 reads 尋予副都統銜: 副都統 is a banner military rank (vice commander-in-chief), not a Censorate office. The prior literal's 'vice president of the Censorate' is a mistranslation; the proposed 'vice banner commander' matches the Chinese and the unit's idiomatic rendering.

decisions.reason: s0063 ends 諡文端: 諡 denotes a posthumous name (谥号), not a temple name (庙号). Replacing 'temple name' with 'posthumous name Wenduan' corrects the English while preserving the rest of the sentence.
s0120 ends 諡文清: 諡 is a posthumous name, not a temple name. The proposed swap to 'posthumous name Wenqing' is accurate; the remaining funeral honors follow the Chinese.
s0146 opens 內閣學士勝保: 內閣學士 is Grand Secretariat Academician, distinct from 大學士 (Grand Secretary). The proposed title fix is correct and leaves the supply-demand narrative intact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 內閣學士勝保督師至河間
